PROP-57888860-inv-052.text: KZG proof verification must correctly handle edge cases where the commitment, proof, or evaluation point is the identity element (point at infinity) of the BLS12-381 G1 group. Pairing checks must not silently pass for degenerate inputs.
PROP-57888860-inv-052.assertion: forall proof_verify(commitment, proof, z, y): if commitment == G1_IDENTITY || proof == G1_IDENTITY => pairing check must still be evaluated correctly, not short-circuited to accept

locations.note: Point-at-infinity is ACCEPTED (line 89-90). Allows infinity commitments/proofs into pairing checks.
Final pairing at line 944 uses pairings_verify with aggregated points that may include infinity points.
Linear combination function used at line 903 for proof aggregation and line 507 for commitment aggregation. Needs verification that infinity points don't cancel contributions.
